title: Avoid using actor names or copyrighted materials in Seedance prompts due to aggressive safeguards that block them.
content: Avoid using actor names or copyrighted materials in Seedance prompts due to aggressive safeguards that block them.
description: There's a very poorly researched blog "debunking" seedance 2.0. It claims Seedance is using a secret library of video clips and secretly doing video to video under the hood instead. I wouldn't norm...
tips: Note: Currently the model has very aggressive safeguards preventing use of actor names or copyrighted materials in the prompts, but there seems to be a bit of a glitch in the system -- I did not prompt the likeness of these actors at all. https://t.co/gLcnapBtCv

zh-CN.content:
避免在Seedance提示中使用演员姓名或受版权保护的材料，因为有严格的防护措施会阻止这些内容。

--- 线程继续 ---
